correctness.rationale: For beta>=2 each completed maximal one-run ends at discrepancy in [-1,0). The initial run has length a+1 only after exactly b initial zeros; any later run after ell zeros has length <=a-1 (ell<b), exactly a (ell=b), or >=a+2 (ell>b). Thus the admissible marker 0^b1^(a+1)0 never returns, excluding all connectors. Exact prefix enumeration corroborates but is not the proof.
